list(APPEND SERVER_SOURCE
    channels/drdynvc/server/drdynvc_main.c
    channels/rdpdr/server/rdpdr_main.c
    channels/server/channels.c
    server/common/server.c)

add_library(winpr ${WINPR_SOURCE})
add_library(freerdp ${FREERDP_SOURCE})
add_library(freerdp-server ${SERVER_SOURCE})

foreach(_target winpr freerdp freerdp-server)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${_target} PRIVATE -w -std=gnu11 -Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types)
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${_target} PRIVATE -fno-autolink -Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types)
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${_target} SYSTEM PUBLIC include winpr/include)
    target_compile_definitions(${_target} PRIVATE
        [[WINPR_RESOURCE_ROOT=""]]
        [[WINPR_TIMEZONE_FILE=""]]
        [[EXT_PATH=""]])
    add_dependencies(${_target} psdk)
endforeach()

target_link_libraries(winpr libssl libcrypto)
target_link_libraries(freerdp winpr)
target_link_libraries(freerdp-server freerdp)
